title: SM-09.16 - How to enable and configure Email Reports
intent: This article answers: SM-09.16 - How to enable and configure Email Reports
short_answer: To enable Email Reports, open the survey settings, activate the Automatic report per email switch, choose the report frequency, and add recipients.
procedure: Find the Automatic report per email switch.
Select the frequency: Never, Daily, Weekly or Monthly.
Enter one or more recipient email addresses separated by semicolons.
Click Add to confirm the recipients.
